summary.text: Sean Tarwater is a Republican state representative who has represented District 27 since January 2017 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026; Ballotpedia lists him as Sean Tarwater Sr.
He chairs the Commerce, Labor and Economic Development Committee and has worked in insurance and as president and CEO of Dealer Development Group Services.

paragraphs.text: Sean Tarwater was born in Kansas City, Kansas, and earned an MBA from the Henry W. Bloch School of Management at the University of Missouri at Kansas City in 1993.

He worked as an account executive for Zurich Insurance from 1993 to 2000, as principal of Integrity Mobile, LLC from 2012 to 2016, and as president and CEO of Dealer Development Group Services beginning in 2000.
He has served as president of the River Ridge Farms Homeowner Association and as chair of the Saint Michael the Archangel Finance Council.
Tarwater was first elected to the Kansas House in 2016 and took office on January 9, 2017.
For 2025 and 2026 he is assigned to the Appropriations, Insurance, Commerce, Labor and Economic Development (chair), State-Tribal Relations, and Legislative Post Audit committees.
